execution: UNEXECUTED behavioral and failure-injection specifications; source inspection only

cases.given: A role is selected but /pool is not mounted
cases.expect: Refuse managed engine/build store creation before mutation; never fall back to root or home storage.

cases.given: Medium/full desktop with the existing rootless account and XFS /pool
cases.expect: Retain Podman graphroot, volumes, image-copy staging and Incus dir pool below /pool; no existing-store reset or mapping change.

cases.given: Managed Incus pool, image/backup/log volume settings and native ETag
cases.expect: Use owner-marked native custom volumes on /pool for image, backup and instance-log storage; preserve unrelated configuration and refuse conflicting settings or volume owners. An uncertain native relocation retains its transaction and is not retried.
Separate users, graphroots, build/cache/tmp directories and user sockets; no host management socket or desktop credentials.
Create private per-account pool roots and explicit Cargo/Go/Mise/Bazel/container configuration; reject preexisting mismatched ownership, mode or bytes without migration.

cases.given: Two source repositories have the same basename
cases.expect: Derive disjoint private pool job roots from each canonical repository path, while preserving source workspace ownership.
Rendered worker, cache tarball, sbuild and autopkgtest release use exactly the selected native suite, with no Forky default on Trixie.

cases.given: An authenticated caller submits another account artifact, traversal, symlink, replaced inode or unsafe parent
cases.expect: Reject before repository mutation; accept only exact caller-owned private project/job artifacts and copy through descriptors to root-only staging.

cases.given: Mapped-UID build requires a traversable temporary parent
cases.expect: Use only root-owned sticky /pool/tmp and package-created private child roots; never relax private account parents.

cases.given: A native store mutation times out or loses process identity
cases.expect: Retain its ownership journal and exact recovery evidence, distinguish outcome unknown, and never retry/reset automatically.
